text:
sophie: Heads up — customer flagged a mismatch in the API ref for the /v1/generate endpoint. curl example shows `max_new_tokens: null` while the JS SDK snippet uses `max_new_tokens: 64` (int). cc @ken, filing a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784 :eyes:

ken: thanks. saw that. looks like we accidentally included the legacy example that treats `max_new_tokens` as nullable. docs schema says optional integer, not nullable. quick question: did the server change semantics recently? @maria?

maria: API hasn't changed — `max_new_tokens` is optional and treated the same as omitted when null, but we should not show `null` in sample requests. customer confusion is valid.

jonathan: agree with maria. examples should show a numeric value or omit the field. also the python sample has `max_new_tokens=None` which is ambiguous for readers. we should standardize: show `// set to 64` or remove.

ken: Patch uploaded that replaces `null` with a short comment and standardizes to `64` where a value is present. Also added a note in the param description: "optional integer — omit to use default". PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784/files

sophie: thanks @ken. Can we also add a tiny migration note for SDK users who upgraded from older clients that did accept null? Something like: "Older clients allowed null; server treats null as omitted — prefer omitting the field or passing an integer."

maria: sg. I'll sign off on the API wording.

jonathan: want to backport to /v1-stable branch docs for enterprise customers on pinned versions. @ken can you add a second commit targeting `v1-stable`?

ken: yep — will open a separate backport PR after this merges.

docs-bot: reminder — please add a change note entry in `docs/changes.md` for the example clarification so it shows up in release notes.

ken: added changelog note in the PR now. also fixed python snippet from `None` to `# omit or use 64` style comment and updated curl example to not include `null`.

sophie: perfect. after merge can someone watch digits bot / examples smoke test? want to ensure generated snippets in the site build look right.

maria: i can kick off the site build and eyeball the generated pages.

jonathan: thanks all. if any customer asks for strict null semantics, we'll escalate, but current behavior stands. closing loop after merge. :white_check_mark:
